class.name: IfcWorkSchedule
class.brief_description: An IfcWorkSchedule represents a task schedule of a work plan, which in turn can contain a set of schedules for different purposes. HISTORY: New Entity in IFC Release 2.0 Assignment Use Definition An IfcWorkSchedule controls a set of tasks and resources defined through IfcRelAssignsToControl .
